subject.title: fix: respect local Crabbox provider preferences

question: Should a user-level Crabbox provider persistently override OpenClaw’s repository Blacksmith Testbox default for ordinary trusted validation?
rationale: Crabbox intentionally gives repository config higher precedence than user config, while this PR describes the opposite policy; choosing whether to change that cross-repository contract cannot be resolved as a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Preserve repository Testbox default
options.body: Keep current Crabbox precedence and require explicit CLI or environment overrides when another eligible provider is wanted.

options.title: Sponsor persistent operator preference
options.body: Define a distinct higher-precedence Crabbox preference contract and cover user, repository, environment, CLI, platform, trust, and fallback behavior together.

recommendation.title: Preserve repository Testbox default
recommendation.body: Keep current Crabbox precedence and require explicit CLI or environment overrides when another eligible provider is wanted.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent OpenClaw wrapper ownership and upstream Crabbox precedence history make this the strongest available routing candidate for the policy choice.
